properties.notes: This is the Outline planning permission for the major regeneration project for Camp Hill. Ref: 029715. The site is being delivered by the Pride in Camphill project on a phased approach. The remaining land to which the Outline permission relates is occupied by residential dwellings, which are to be demolished a part of the redevelopment project. The Area (Ha) is approximate.. Residential development (Outline with all matters reserved) . Existing houses to be demolished.
